finding: The legacy V4.74 guild/home bridge still manipulated #world during startup, pageshow and navigation.
markModernHomeReady() repeatedly queried #world, moved .v366-world, hid sibling children and forced display/visibility/opacity styles.
It also wrapped v032Go and scheduled additional startup passes at 180 ms, 900 ms and 2200 ms.
The current beta already has the canonical V366 Startseite owner, so this historical home enforcement is redundant and can fight later render owners.
changes: In beta, V4.74 markModernHomeReady() is retired and performs no DOM changes.
The legacy v032Go home wrapper is no longer installed in beta.
Startup/pageshow/delayed V4.74 calls keep the guild RPC guard but skip all Startseite DOM enforcement.
